notes.title: Chapter 2 development news
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone! This is Lucky Cat, the solo dev behind The Silent Kingdom.[/p][p][/p][p]I'd like to offer some updates on how the development for chapter 2 is going. I've been working on mapping, programming, and I'm currently focusing on the script. Script-wise, I'm about to reach the final arch from chapter 2, which happens in the Lectica castle.[/p][p][/p][p]Chapter 2 dialogues have been the hardest because there are many variables at play. There isn't a single scene that doesn't make me rack my brains hahaha. For example, recently I wrote a scene that involves my favourite secondary NPC (Christoph), and there were 7 variables I had to take into account, based on past player choices. 7 variables that were changing the way the scene unfolded and kept interferring heavily with the dialogue. I was going crazy.[/p][p][/p][p]I often face challenges with the script, but I think this mighty sacrifice of my brain cells will be worth it.[/p][p][/p][p]On a side note, there will be maps where backers from the Kickstarter have left their fingerprints, like this cemetery whose tombstones contain messages from backers (this screen is just a WIP, I must still add an NPC).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620871/572af7db70b1ac253b299c456d7a8f7cd864333b.png"][/img][/p][p]Last but not least, the usual reminder that my plan is to make chapter 2 and 3 together, and then release the full game, instead of updating it little by little. I also hope to add a CG gallery, tweak some dialogue, and if possible, add a Japanese voiceover![/p][p][/p][p]One step at a time.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support! I'll continue working on the script now. I'm very glad that summer is leaving, so the heat won't get in the way.[/p]

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale and development news
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone! This is Lucky Cat, the solo dev behind The Silent Kingdom. I'll be making this post in English only again to save time. I apologise for the trouble.[/p][p][/p][p]First of all, The Silent Kingdom is participating in the Steam Summer Sale with a discount![/p][p][/p][p]I've been working on the next half of the game non stop. Mapping, programming, some script, and some graphics like sprite animations. Story wise, I might be halfway through chapter 2 (the Lectica arc). It's a lot of work because it has many new animations and maps. Several maps will be visited once and briefly, but they are necessary.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are some previews:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620871/5dd2096705c17949b50ea47f25f0a5a3369ccd06.png"][/img]"I had never seen a bird eat a man."[/p][p][/p][p]This is one of the new NPCs you'll meet. Friend or foe?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620871/bba06c02f9e5ca57e76d576b3e313bc5b100b35f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As for CG/still art, So far I have 17 illustrations pending to draw. Since I tend to leave illustrations for last, I use embarrassing placeholder art while programming. Drawn with my mouse and my left hand.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620871/f65612b92852515079c729ab8f7d4114686daaff.png"][/img]P-please don't judge me too harshly ;;;;[/p][p]When this CG is done in the future, I'll publish it. For now, your eyes can enjoy this timeless masterpiece before it disappears forever.[/p][p][/p][p]As you might know, the Early Access contains the prologue and the Fortuna arc. I'm currently working to make the Lectica and Somnia arcs together, so that I can finally update and release the game in its final form. I'm also trying to save up for Japanese voices. Getting all the funding I need for that will be tricker than I thought, but I'll see what my possibilities are when the time arrives.[/p][p][/p][p]For now, I'll keep focusing on my tasks at hand. One step at a time.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support and kind reviews! It always makes me happy to see that people are finding enjoyment in my game. I'll keep doing my best to see it finished![/p]

notes.title: The Silent Kingdom development news
notes.notes:
[i](This post will be in English only. I apologise for not translating it to the other languages, but writing the post several times takes a long time and I'd rather use that time for developing the game.)[/i]

Hello everyone! This is Lucky Cat, the solo developer behind The Silent Kingdom.

Since the launch of Early Access / Chapter 1, I've been working on the next part non stop. I've worked on the script (99 pages written so far, though I'm still not halfway), and also on some mapping and programming of the first scenes.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/c90bb07ef544b25c1ce9c64223caf075091beb23.png[/img]

I'd like to talk about my plans with the development and final game launch.

First of all, there's some feedback I need to implement and a minor bug to correct in chapter 1. However, since I'm already developing the next part, I won't update the Early Access version further. So all the feedback will be implemented when the game fully launches.

As you might know, my plan is to work on the Lectica and Somnia arcs together, so the next time the game is updated it'll contain the whole story and endings. That'll be the official launch out of early access.

[u][b]Chapter 1 improvements that I'd like to implement for the final game:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Increased ratio in which some enemies drop potions.
[*] A certain part of a dungeon will be made a bit less dark.
[*] A book item to access the batle tutorials any time.
[*] Tweak some dialogue in Fortuna's castle to make it more obvious that the court is its own battlefield.
[*] Correction of a bug that makes the princess walk slower during a certain scene.
[*] Improvements of the Japanese translation.
[/list](Maybe there's more that I might be forgetting right now ;;; )


[u][b]New important features planned for the final game:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] CG gallery.
[*] [b]Japanese voices!!![/b]
[/list]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/db580a141be008284fff51339f3133b479e3905c.png[/img]

About the Japanese voice acting, I've found the means and got a bit of funding for it, so it's 99% certain that it'll happen!! You can't imagine how excited I am; this is a huge dream for me.

With the current funding, however, I'll only be able to add voices to some scenes. I'll also be limited in what seiyuu I can choose. So, in case you played chapter 1 the Jack Sparrow way and liked it, please consider supporting the game hahaha. The more funds it raises now, the better the final version will be for everyone.

To all the people who supported the game and let me know of their impressions and feedback, I can't state enough how thankful I am. Every time someone tells me that they enjoyed the journey, I feel renewed energies to keep working hard on it, as all of you have made me believe in this project more than ever.

Thank you very much. And off to work I go!

notes.title: CG gallery?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'd like to start by saying that I'm insanely happy with the warm reception the game has received. I'm getting a lot of positive feedback both on Steam and other media, and that makes me feel that all the effort I've put into this project has been very worthwhile.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/8e65b9a5fbd3f0871c5b060aed27b5e0a4b054b2.png[/img]

I wanted to talk about one of the requests I'm getting the most: a CG gallery.

It's actually something I've wanted to add from the beginning, for the game has a lot of CGs and I think it's fun to collect them. If I haven't been able to do it yet, it's because I don't know coding and also didn't know anyone who could help me, but now I have several people who've offered to help me with coding issues.

I just wanted to let you know that the gallery is on its way, and my plan is to have it implemented by the time chapter 2 is released.

I'll keep listening to all the feedback to improve the game as much as I can, within my humble limitations.

Thank you again, and I hope you keep enjoying this story as much as I'm enjoying making it!

notes.notes:

October's Steam Next Fest has arrived, and The Silent Kingdom is participating!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/29f9d8da7a76064ceae2d621f0e332a313458106.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Small update based on feedback
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Since the 1.0 demo was released, I've been taking note of feedback. I'm happy that the demo has been so well received, and I've been working quickly on the changes that many players were asking for. I want it to be as good as possible for Next Fest!

Over the course of this week, the demo has received a couple of updates:

[list]
[*]The rate of enemy encounters in the forest has been decreased.
[*]The tutorial on the double attack mechanics of the princess is more explicit and clearer now.
[*]Characters now show a new pose when blocking normal attacks. The sound is also more noticeable, making it easier to tell when you've successfully blocked.
[*]The battle start effect has been changed to a more eye-catching broken glass effect.
[*]Guards give twice as much experience as before.
[*]Added a plugin to prevent screen freezing with >60Hz monitors.
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/224e1684d01000c99b1f718e650f329ccce58c0f.gif[/img]

Thank you all for testing the demo and for your feedback! Your comments give me a lot of encouragement to keep working, and also help me to improve the game.

notes.title: 1.0 demo has arrived!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm happy to announce that...the 1.0 demo is now a reality!

This version contains the new battle system, its own original OST (composed by Mikel Dale), improved graphics and dialogues, and other details like autosaving. I've put a lot of effort into making it as polished as possible.

I'm so glad that I can finally share this definitive version of what The Silent Kingdom will be. The old demo was outdated a long time ago, but I couldn't replace it because the battle system wasn't ready until now, and that was killing me inside a little bit hahaha.

If you play it, I'd love to hear your impressions!

[previewyoutube=59lxDTF7nds;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Since 1.0 uses a different translation plugin, players who downloaded the alpha demo back in the day will get an [b]Uncaught TypeError[/b] message when they open the game now.

To solve it, go to the folder where the game is installed. Then go into www>save, and delete all the files inside the save folder. That should solve the issue!

notes.title: The Silent Kingdom - New Battle System
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

I'm in the final months of production on chapter 1. As I said in the previous post, I've been working on the prologue's battle system, and I can finally show a preview!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/93630166ad46559c88b9964ba96f029ddcff2344.gif[/img]

In the alpha demo I published back in the day, the combat system was very simple. It was like that because I spent 5 months working on that demo with hardly any rest, not knowing if anyone would be interested in the game or if it was going to be funded. I couldn't spend more time and energy on it, so I left the vanilla RPG Maker combat system and focused on the story, which was what mattered.

When the project was funded, I decided that the game deserved an eye-catching combat system, even though the story will remain the main element.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/fd1978e082f88077bc429de370d336fb2a5f5695.png[/img]

In this video you can see part of a fight in more detail.

[previewyoutube=ZVbz3SXQL-g;full][/previewyoutube]

The skills have been designed by my friend Chivs. I'm in charge of the rest. I've been trying my best to make the character animations look as good as possible, although I'm not an animator and it's been a bit difficult. I'm learning a lot of things while making this game hahaha.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/db580a141be008284fff51339f3133b479e3905c.png[/img]

Now that the prologue has finally been completed with the new combat system, [b]the 1.0 demo is ready for October's Steam Next Fest[/b], when it will be released.

Until then, I'm still working on the rest of chapter 1. I'm currently animating the party characters that appear after the prologue, namely the Knight and the Princess protagonist in full armour (in the prologue she only fights in her white dress). I also have to draw the new enemies you will encounter throughout the chapter, and program the new skills.

All this said, back to work I go. Thank you for your interest and see you soon!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/db580a141be008284fff51339f3133b479e3905c.png[/img]

Many thanks to all of you who have added The Silent Kingdom to your wishlist! I will continue to work diligently to get Chapter 1 out as soon as possible. If you'd like to follow news about the development more closely, don't hesitate to visit the [url=https://twitter.com/LuckyCatOtome]official twitter account[/url].

notes.title: Important News.
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Many things have happened since the last time I made a post on Steam.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41620871/16b1247983db4490bf37589b2cdcaa3607e6dd22.png[/img]

The Silent Kingdom's Kickstarter campaign went live and got fuinded in 9 hours and 14 minutes! After that, several stretch goals have been reached, like one that will turn the first person combat system into third person with battle sprites!

This means that [b]The Silent Kingdom is going to become a full game[/b], and will be released on Steam as an Early Access by the end of this year or the beginning of the next.

The [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1039568441/the-silent-kingdom-dark-otome-rpg]Kickstarter campaign[/url] is still running. Grab the exclusive rewards and free DLC for backers now, before it's too late!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41620871/db580a141be008284fff51339f3133b479e3905c.png[/img]

In preparation for making the full game, the [b]demo[/b] has received a graphical update and some tweaks:

[list]
[*] Changes in the backgrounds, which now look less pixelated and more fitting with the character sprites.
[/list]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41620871/c06bb3598318097306199bf08d0968ca591cb664.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Corrected the distance between party members. No longer shall the princess feel the magician's breathing on her neck!
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added a function to hide the text box with the mouse's right click. Now you can enjoy the art whenever you'd like!
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41620871/db580a141be008284fff51339f3133b479e3905c.png[/img]

A first beta for backers is coming to Steam around June/July. You can find more information in the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1039568441/the-silent-kingdom-dark-otome-rpg]Kickstarter page[/url].

As always, I want to thank everyone who is supporting this project. It's thanks to you that this game will become a reality ^^

notes.title: Demo Updated (22-2-22)
notes.notes:
The demo has received what likely is its last update.

[list]
[*] Due to stretchgoals reached during the Kickstarter campaign, [b]2 new CGs[/b] have been added to existing scenes. One of "The Magician" and one of "The Knight".

[*] The gallery has been removed, for it was barely used and was actually bugged. Instead, a "[b]Quest[/b]" section has been added, where you may consult what the next step for the main quest is. This will come in handy for people who get lost and don't know what to do next.

[*] Some new texts have been added. A few of the old ones have been corrected.
[/list]

Now that the demo is finished, I shall work on the Kickstarter campaign relaunch. We were so close despite the fact that not many people knew us! As always, most news will be shared on [url=https://twitter.com/LuckyCatOtome]twitter[/url].
